newsitem.title: USA: New York Cotton Exchange elects Weis as chairman.
newsitem.headline: New York Cotton Exchange elects Weis as chairman.

text.p: The members of the New York Cotton Exchange (NYCE) have elected Albert Weis to a one-year term as Chairman, exchange officials said.
Weis, a member of the exchange since 1951, was chosen on Thursday at an annual election here. He has served two prior terms as chairman, in 1978-1980 and 1982-1983.
In addition, outgoing NYCE chairman John Ruffino was elected as vice-chairman, and Marc Brenner was elected as treasurer.
